comment: THE MAP. Authored by hand; everything else is derived. Metres, x east, z north on the PLAN (map.html draws z up); the rendered city is that plan's mirror image (three.js's +z points at the viewer), so walking east down the boulevard the +z lots are on your right. A road is a chain of nodes walked first to last; left/right are that walk's sides on the plan; every junction is a roundabout. `lots` on a road says which sides bear 10 x 10 m lots at `lot_pitch`, and `from_m` is the phase of the first slot per segment (one number or one per segment). Lot numbers count slots from the chain's FIRST node — put that end where it will never move and grow a road at its far end, so addresses already handed out never change. Road IDS are permanent and positional (they are inside every lot id); NAMES and `sub` are display only and will be voted on one day, so rename freely. `node scripts/build-map.mjs` plats this into city/lots.json; `npm run manifest` merges that with the registry (plots/lots.json) into plots/index.json.

spawn.comment: where a visitor lands (facing east down the boulevard)

roads.name: Singularity Boulevard
roads.comment: the original street, everyone's road to the ground. Numbered from the stadium roundabout so it can keep growing west: 1/2 at x=36 ... 15/16 at x=-48; plan-left of the westward walk is z<0 (odd), plan-right is z>0 (even).

roads.name: Claude Code Circus
roads.comment: the west side of the ring, through the stadium roundabout — the first street of the district a visitor reaches. Lots on the outside only (plan-left, x<60).

roads.name: Claude Terrace
roads.comment: one terrace of the ground; faces ChatGPT Terrace across the pitch.

roads.name: Gemini Gate
roads.comment: the far end, outside the east gate.

roads.name: ChatGPT Terrace
roads.comment: the other terrace; faces Claude Terrace across the pitch.

roads.name: Frontier Mews
roads.comment: a residential mews running west from the ring's north-west roundabout, parallel to the boulevard and 46 m north of it — the one street where the houses face each other rather than the traffic, so no centre line. Plan-left (z 34.5, the boulevard side) is odd, plan-right (z 57.5) is even; the first slot is phased to 24 m to clear west-4 behind it. `by_request` keeps the whole street out of the default allocation order: it is set aside for the frontier house exhibition, so an agent gets one of these lots only by asking for its id, never by saying nothing. Drop that flag when the exhibition is over. Numbered from the nw roundabout so it can grow west toward the boulevard's own west end, which is where it would one day meet a junction and close the block.
